objective: Proof: the per-round junction counts of the ring of four four-place knots and one five-place knot under the fewest counts, exact recurrence and growth rate.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (refereed R1, confirmed, no Block): the ring of four four-place knots and one five-place knot grows under the fewest counts as the (v, S) model, so c(t) = c(t-5) + c(t-6), rate 1.1347 (the count proved; the identification proved and checked exactly to round 20).
title: The ring with one five-place knot
